scope: Primary evidence for NAND physical latency/reliability placement; facts and access limitations are explicit. No performance numbers are transferred between devices.

sources.title: AiF: Accelerating On-Device LLM Inference Using In-Flash Processing
sources.read_depth: Original supplied full paper previously read; sections 4.3-4.4 and Table 2 rechecked this round.
sources.evidence: Bias-error encoding changes conventional (2,3,2) sensing to (1,3,3), placing all IFP weights in reliable, single-sensing LSB pages. Be-enc LSB/CSB/MSB reads are 28/46/46 us; conventional reads 37/46/37 us. BCH ECCLITE corrects 10 bits/1KiB. Characterization covers 160 TLC chips, 120 blocks/chip and 3,686,400 WLs; raw tables were not located.
sources.relevance: An all-LSB baseline already consumes the ordinary fast-page opportunity. Disabling CR does not imply disabling be-enc. Slow-page weight placement must establish compatible inline ECC and input-latch operation.
sources.hardware_limits: IFP weights only LSB; general data may use CSB/MSB. Full block pSLC conversion is a different capacity choice. No validated heavy-LDPC fallback/PE execution protocol published.

artifact.timing_emulation: NVMeVirt modifications in evaluation; upstream NVMeVirt is not the AiF artifact

sources.title: Improving NAND flash performance with read heat separation
sources.read_depth: IBM original abstract/metadata and indexed original proceeding excerpts. Author PDF timed out/TLS hostname issue; full paper not claimed read.
sources.evidence: Read-hot user data are placed on low-latency page types. Authors report both simulation and implementation in a commercial enterprise SSD controller.
sources.relevance: Direct prior against claiming hot experts on fast NAND pages as novel.
sources.hardware_limits: Controller manages page types and flash-specific programming constraints; does not establish arbitrary per-plane GEMV placement.

sources.title: ReadGuard: Integrated SSD Management for Priority-Aware Read Performance Differentiation
sources.read_depth: Indexed original sections 4-7 and 9 read; formatted full PDF not obtained.
sources.evidence: nr(B) predicts the retry count of a block's slowest page. Quality allocation follows application priority, with inversion migration and write-amplification budget. Device characterization uses 40 real 3D TLC chips and supplies a model to MQSim.
sources.relevance: Priority-aware quality placement, worst-page retries and migration cost are established mechanisms.
sources.hardware_limits: Conventional retry/ECC controller; latency depends on P/E and retention. Not evidence that AiF ECCLITE can execute on all such degraded pages.

sources.title: Straw: A Stress-Aware WL-Based Read Reclaim Technique for High-Density NAND Flash-Based SSDs
sources.version: arXiv:2501.02517v1, 2025-01-05; accepted 2024-11-24. The acceptance date is not the publication year.
sources.read_depth: Entire short original paper, especially sections II-IV, read.
sources.evidence: 160 real Samsung 3D TLC chips/19,200 blocks. Adjacent WL read disturbance is 8.4 times non-adjacent on average. Four WL quality groups have PEC-specific alpha and ERCmax. Good group at 2K PEC: alpha=9, ERCmax=767K non-adjacent reads. FTL tracks WL/block reads and reclaims only stressed valid WLs. Parameters require offline target-chip profiling.
sources.relevance: Most direct executable measured-device-derived model for neighbor-dependent placement and maintenance. A full-block sequential scan is distinct from repeated reads to one WL.
sources.hardware_limits: MQSim-E evaluation; table uses 321 vertical WLs/block, 7704 pages/block, read40us/program380us/erase3500us. These are not AiF constants.

artifact.published_model: equations, selected figure parameters and configuration available

sources.title: STRAW: Stress-Aware WL-Based Read Disturbance Management for High-Density NAND Flash Memory
sources.read_depth: Primary program/registered metadata verified. Full paper not obtained. Extended abstract text is visible through indexes but not independently audited against full primary PDF.
sources.evidence: Indexed abstract describes stress-aware WL reclaim and stress-reduced read, scaling pass-through voltage according to WL validity.
sources.relevance: Must resolve before claiming invalid/guard-WL placement plus lower Vpass as a contribution.
sources.hardware_limits: Do not attribute the 2026 added voltage mechanism to CAL/arXiv v1. No detailed implementation or measured dataset verified.

sources.title: Improving 3D NAND Flash Memory Lifetime by Tolerating Early Retention Loss and Process Variation
sources.read_depth: Original sections 4.1-4.2 and 6.1-6.2, selected retention sections; not an exhaustive full-paper audit.
sources.evidence: Real 3D MLC from one vendor, room-temperature measurement, anonymized layer numbering and threshold voltages. LaVAR adapts Vref by layer; LI-RAID mixes layers and page types in redundancy groups to avoid correlated weak locations. ReMAR models retention/PEC; ReNAC uses neighbor-state information.
sources.relevance: Measured spatial variation is real, but optimized read-voltage and correlation-aware placement are strong existing baselines.
sources.hardware_limits: No chip-to-chip characterization claimed. Old MLC generation, proprietary normalized voltages; not a contemporary AiF TLC retry map.

sources.title: Layer RBER Variation Aware Read Performance Optimization for 3D Flash Memories
sources.read_depth: Original abstract, sections II and III design introduction read, including SOML restrictions and FPA ECC-space rationale. Remaining implementation/results not fully audited.
sources.evidence: SRS groups small reads from layers with similar RBER. FPA spreads full-page subpages across layers and shares ECC space from stronger with weaker subpages. SOML reads subpages from different blocks/layers, which cannot share bitlines or block decoders. Its layer RBER/read-retry plots cite earlier characterization.
sources.relevance: Existing physical mapping to avoid latency barriers and redistribute reliability cost. It is not a new raw hardware dataset.
sources.hardware_limits: Requires SOML subpage hardware; cannot import its parallelism into an ordinary four-plane AiF model.

sources.title: FTL optimization for 3D NAND flash considering layer RBER variation and data precision
sources.venue: Future Generation Computer Systems 185, article 108682; December issue
sources.read_depth: Original public abstract, introduction and section snippets read. Full article not obtained. Indexed public content existed before 2026-11-02; December is issue date, not assumed current date.
sources.evidence: Extends LRR with error-resilience-aware page allocation: approximate data to high-RBER pages and exact data to low-RBER pages. Evaluation is SSDsim-based.
sources.relevance: Assigning model precision/error-tolerance classes to physical reliability levels is established prior, even if MoE-specific evaluation is absent.
sources.hardware_limits: Approximate errors change model semantics; exact W8A8 cannot simply disable ECC. SOML dependencies inherited.

sources.title: Page Type-Aware Data Migration Technique for Read Disturb Management of NAND Flash Memory
sources.read_depth: Original sections III-B/III-C and IV-A from indexed author PDF, supplement figures. Not full numerical replication.
sources.evidence: Migrates vulnerable page types selectively and distributes hot reads across blocks. Cold blocks capped at 10%; hot-block redistribution needs free/low-read-count blocks or GC. Simulation tables cite latency and page-type disturb thresholds.
sources.relevance: Strong prior for page-type reliability-aware migration, read-hot separation and selective refresh.
sources.hardware_limits: Its MLC 5us/42us and TLC60us table is configuration, not a universal device law or AiF calibration. Free-space/GC expense must be preserved.

sources.title: SWEEP: Gathering Hot Read/Write Data Together to Minimize Read Reclaims in SSDs
sources.read_depth: Publisher-registered original abstract and indexed introduction; author repository README and top-level inventory read. Source functions not audited or executed.
sources.evidence: Packs hot reads with hot writes so invalidations trigger GC, resetting read disturbance without separate reclaim. Repository includes SSDsim-style ssd/flash/pagemap/initialize C sources and parameter file.
sources.relevance: Most directly reusable public implementation candidate for endogenous maintenance placement; generic mixing to reduce refresh is not new.
sources.hardware_limits: Static inference weights have few writes, so the beneficial hot-write turnover may not exist. Synthetic extra writes cannot be free. Public source is a simulator, not raw NAND measurements.

artifact.code: public, paper-named README, three commits seen
artifact.license: no explicit LICENSE seen in top-level inventory; inspect before reuse

sources.title: DWR: Differential Wearing for Read Performance Optimization on High-Density NAND Flash Memory
sources.read_depth: Original design, migration policy and section IV-A experimental setup read; full PDF fetched and text searched.
sources.evidence: Physically partitions each plane into low/high wearing areas. Multiple-read data requiring retries migrate to low-wear area; threshold depends on life stage. Evaluation uses SSDsim and 16-chip TLC configuration. The retry/latency stage table follows prior read-retry work, rather than new raw device measurements.
sources.relevance: Direct prior against hot experts on low-PEC/low-retry blocks as a new mechanism.
sources.hardware_limits: Needs ongoing writes to create wear separation and explicit lifetime/space management. High stage-dependent LDPC retry tables do not characterize all-LSB AiF ECCLITE.

sources.title: Latency Variation Aware Read Performance Optimization on 3D High Density NAND Flash Memory
sources.read_depth: Original publisher abstract and metadata only; full text not read.
sources.evidence: RLV identifies read hotness and moves data to physical positions with corresponding multi-bit-page latency.
sources.relevance: Independent explicit prior against generic hot-to-fast multi-bit placement.
sources.hardware_limits: Detailed programming, measurement and evaluation assumptions not audited.

sources.title: Read latency variation aware performance optimization on high-density NAND flash based storage systems
sources.venue: CCF Transactions on High Performance Computing 4, 265-280
sources.read_depth: Original public abstract and references/metadata only; subscription full text not obtained.
sources.evidence: Combines read-hotness/fine-grained migration, slow-page caching and life-stage-aware metadata placement.
sources.relevance: Read-cost placement plus caching/migration and age awareness is already combined prior.
sources.hardware_limits: No exact mechanism performance transferred to AiF.

sources.title: Exploiting Process Similarity of 3D Flash Memory for High Performance SSDs
sources.read_depth: Author-institution original abstract and official program only; full text not obtained this round.
sources.evidence: Same horizontal layer's WLs within a block have strong process similarity; reuses leading-WL operating parameters to reduce redundant read/program steps. Implements cubeFTL and mixed programming order.
sources.relevance: Physical geometry-aware parameter reuse is prior, and baselines should not use an unnecessarily naive universal read voltage.
sources.hardware_limits: Abstract does not establish independent contexts/planes or inter-chip distributions.

sources.title: FlexFS: A Flexible Flash File System for MLC NAND Flash Memory
sources.read_depth: Original abstract, introduction and sections 3-4 read selectively.
sources.evidence: Dynamically manages SLC/MLC regions, balancing speed and capacity with migration/erase cost; prototype on Linux/embedded board.
sources.relevance: Dynamic pseudo-SLC/multi-bit tiering is longstanding, not a MoE placement novelty by itself.
sources.hardware_limits: Old MLC board; modern TLC pSLC timing/capacity/programming must be independently established. SLC/TLC block conversion is not equivalent to AiF retaining general data in CSB/MSB.

sources.title: QCFlash: Bulk Bitwise Processing in 3D NAND with Dynamic Sensing and Quad-level Encoding — Artifact
sources.read_depth: Downloaded 14,214,527-byte archive in memory; README, ZIP inventory and workbook sheet/header structure inspected. Not an end-to-end device-timing reproduction.
sources.evidence: Measured Micron 96-layer QLC MT29F2T08GELBEJ4 cell Vth and programmed shared-page data. Archive contains three datasets vth_states_wl10.xlsx, wl11, wl12, with cell/state/Vth/reference and LSB/CSB/MSB/TSB data. Functional sensing, offset optimization and RBER scripts.
sources.relevance: Verified open measured data useful for sensing/encoding tests, insufficient for whole-device quality placement.
sources.hardware_limits: No sweep over chips/PEC/retention/read-disturb history and no measured service-time traces in inspected archive. Three neighboring WLs cannot calibrate a global reliability/capacity distribution.

sources.title: Flash-Gen: Spatio-Temporal Generator for Flash Memory Systems
sources.version: Author accepted manuscript dated 2024-08-07; final February 2025 issue
sources.read_depth: Original introduction, implementation/datasets section III-C, model mechanism excerpts and code/data-link search; remaining evaluation selectively inspected, not fully audited.
sources.evidence: Measured one commercial 1X-nm TLC chip at 4K/7K/10K P/E and retention timestamps 0/tau/2tau. Crops measured program/read-voltage pairs into 64x64 arrays; generative model supports coding and sensing evaluation. 3D extension is discussed as a possible generalization.
sources.relevance: A measured-data-derived generator is not a measured physical-latency trace, and unlimited generated samples do not expand chip/geometry coverage.
sources.hardware_limits: Not established contemporary 3D WL/chip retry map. No read-disturb sweep in inspected dataset description.

sources.title: Reducing Solid-State Drive Read Latency by Optimizing Read-Retry
sources.read_depth: Original retry mechanism and characterization previously read; not reread in full this round.
sources.evidence: 160 real 48-layer TLC chips; uses cache-read pipelining and ECC-margin-aware reduction of retry sensing latency.
sources.relevance: A strong retry baseline; cache-read is distinct from charge-recycling CR-read.
sources.hardware_limits: Requires supported cache-read/ECC control. Published characterization is not a public per-location service trace for AiF.

sources.title: SLIM: A Heterogeneous Accelerator for Edge Inference of Sparse Large Language Model via Adaptive Thresholding
sources.read_depth: Original sections 5.4, 6.1-6.3, 7.1 and 7.6 read in preceding round.
sources.evidence: Page-aligns fused FFN vectors, evenly distributes dies, holds finite B*L*D inputs and reads corresponding weights once. 16 die MACs/64KiB input SRAM; no multi-plane read implemented.
sources.relevance: Fused neuron/page mapping, frequency/sparsity and read-once batching are prior, not newly created by physical quality placement.
sources.hardware_limits: Custom ASIC, approximate sparse neurons; no measured reliability-aware NAND map.

sources.title: RecFlash: Fast Recommendation Inference on NAND Flash-Based In-Storage Computing with Embedding-Optimized Data Mapping
sources.read_depth: Original sections III-IV read in preceding round.
sources.evidence: Hot embeddings co-located in pages, hot pages distributed across planes, finite 128KiB controller SRAM LRU page cache.
sources.relevance: Frequency-aware physical locality plus plane parallelism and caching already combined; small embedding lookups differ from full expert matrices.
sources.hardware_limits: Not a measured reliability-aware NAND-CIM placement dataset.

sources.title: NASiC: 3D NAND-based CAM-Selected Multibit CIM Architecture for Efficient On-Device Mixture-of-Experts LLM Inference
sources.read_depth: Original architecture section 3 and methodology section 4.1 read in preceding round.
sources.evidence: NAND CAM expert-ID selection and multibit analog CIM with interleaved weight placement; circuit/device simulation using 65nm floating-gate models.
sources.relevance: Most direct MoE physical-array prior, but its analog selection and geometry are different from digital page-buffer AiF GEMV.
sources.hardware_limits: SPICE/Verilog-A plus system evaluation; no measured full NAND-CIM inference chip and no verified spatial-reliability artifact.

unverified_watchlist.title: Layer Deadline-aware Refresh Scheduling for Minimizing I/O Interference in 3D NAND Flash
unverified_watchlist.read_depth: Crossref title/year/venue verified; full primary abstract/paper not obtained. Search surfaced reproduced abstract; mechanism/performance intentionally not used as primary evidence.
unverified_watchlist.reason_to_check: Possible direct prior for layer-retention-deadline-aware page refresh with foreground-idle scheduling. Resolve before making such a novelty claim. Exact online month not verified.
